data.name: A Singular Portrait
data.detailed_description:
STORY

A Singular Portrait is a Visual Novel with an involving story of mystery and discovery, presented through vibrant, watercolor visuals.

Track the struggles of a young student in an unjust reality after she uncovers an invaluable portrait...

Interact with the story events and change the future!

FEATURES:

  • Multiple Endings

  • Watercolor Visuals

  • Over 22,000 words (About 90 minutes of reading)

CREDITS / CC BY:

data.short_description: At what point does a simple desire become an obsession? This is one of the dilemmas faced by Beatrice, a photography student as bitter as reality itself. Within a tangle of unfolding mysteries, she will discover that the most beautiful manifestation of the past holds a chaotic future.
